ohtani.title: Dodgers' four-run inning leads to extra-innings win
ohtani.blurb: Dodgers score four runs in the 10th inning, led by Andy Pages' three-run homer, to beat the Giants, 5-1 for their 100th win of the season

imanaga.title: Alex Bregman goes deep twice in the Cubs' 6-2 win
imanaga.blurb: Alex Bregman collects four hits, with a pair of home runs in the Cubs' 6-2 win against the Red Sox

suzuki.title: Abreu's go-ahead double powers Red Sox' 2-0 win
suzuki.blurb: Wilyer Abreu lines the go-ahead double, plus Jedixson Paez throws five shutout innings as the Red Sox complete the doubleheader sweep

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Max Scherzer shines in Blue Jays' win
okamoto.blurb: Max Scherzer fans seven in a dominant final 2026 outing and Brandon Valenzuela's two-run homer fuel the Blue Jays' 5-1 win over the Reds

murakami.title: Grichuk, Doyle's homers power White Sox past Rockies
murakami.blurb: Randal Grichuk and Brenton Doyle slug two-run home runs to power the White Sox past the Rockies, 4-2

matsui.title: Machado, Bogaerts propel Padres' 10-7 win vs. D-backs
matsui.blurb: Manny Machado records his 30th homer of the season plus Xander Bogaerts drives a two-run homer in the Padres' 10-7 win over the D-backs
